description: This script is an automated OpenWrt package dependency checker, written in Bash. It performs tasks such as setting up build directories, running package tests, handling blacklists, and managing build dependencies.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Builds a package target with make and logs output.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Removes non-essential kernel build directory contents.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file or link exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Performs testing of a specified package, managing stamps, logs, and build environment.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a specific make target for bootstrap processes with logging.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Runs a native bootstrap make command with logging.
